newsitem.title: USA: Gray stake lifted by Gabelli group.
newsitem.headline: Gray stake lifted by Gabelli group.

text.p: A group led by New York investment manager Mario Gabelli said Thursday it raised its stake in Gray Communications Systems Inc to 565,200 common shares or 16.15 percent from 14.99 percent previously held.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it bought 40,500 additional shares between December 12 and December 17 at prices ranging from $15.2279 to $15.75 per share.
The Gabelli group has bought 198,200 additional common shares in Gray since it first reported its initial stake of 10.49 percent on October 7, 1996.
Gray, based in Albany, Ga., owns and operates seven network-affiliated television stations in medium-size markets in the southeastern United States.
